posts.meta_description:
210K likes, 747 comments - kajalaggarwalofficial on September 4, 2026: "On this auspicious occasion of Krishna Janmashtami, may we find our way back to what truly matters: faith, love, compassion and grace. 🦚💙

Perhaps now, more than ever, we need to stay connected- to each other, to our families, to our communities, and most importantly, to the divine within us.

With so much turmoil, uncertainty and noise around us, it is easy to feel overwhelmed. But Lord Krishna reminds us that even in the midst of chaos, there is a higher order; even in darkness, there is light; and even when we don’t have all the answers, grace can show us the way.

May we choose kindness over conflict, faith over fear, and grace over everything that seeks to divide us.

Hare Krishna. 🙏🏻💛
Wishing you and your loved ones a blessed and beautiful Janmashtami. 🪷".
